import os, json
d='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
pairs=[{"input":d1i,"output":d1o},{"input":d2i,"output":d2o},
       {"input":test,"output":transform(test)}]
json.dump(pairs, open(d+'/task-37573f06.json','w'))
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    dots=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    rs=[r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
    cs=[c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ih=(r1-r0-1)//2; iw=(c1-c0-1)//2
    bh=(r1-r0-1)//ih; bw=(c1-c0-1)//iw
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    d0=dots[0]
    best=None
    for bi in range(bh):
        for bj in range(bw):
            br=r0+1+bi*ih+(ih-1)/2; bc=c0+1+bj*iw+(iw-1)/2
            dist=(br-d0[0])**2+(bc-d0[1])**2
            if best is None or dist<best[0]: best=(dist,bi,bj)
    _,bi0,bj0=best
    other=[x for x in dots if x[2]!=d0[2]][0][2]
    for bi in range(bh):
        for bj in range(bw):
            color = d0[2] if (bi-bj0-bj+bi0)%2==0 else other
            for r in range(r0+1+bi*ih, r0+1+(bi+1)*ih):
                for c in range(c0+1+bj*iw, c0+1+(bj+1)*iw):
                    out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
open(d+'/task-37573f06.py','w').write(prog)
# verify program reproduces all kept pairs
